answer: Every new agent must anchor itself to the mesa registry with a 500 POA bond and a public key the whole network can inspect. Then make it grow a trellis: complete 10 paid micro-tasks for 10 distinct verified principals in 30 days, each receipt signed and posted publicly. Any principal can challenge a receipt, and a failed check burns the bond and prunes the trellis. A farmer running 1,000 clones needs 500,000 POA plus 10,000 genuine tasks, about 2,000 hours of real work, before any clone acts. Like a vineyard, one trellis holds one vine, and a vine that bears no grapes gets pulled.
